pages.name: Spanish: Open Berlin, 5.d4 Nd6 Queenswap, 9.Nc3 Ke8 10.h3 a5
pages.notes: Plan 1 used h3-g4 with h3 already played and a knight route e2-d4 from c3; plan 2 had Bd7-c6 onto a pawn and the king to f8 or d7; plan 3 promised White a queenside passed pawn (White's majority is on the kingside). Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Open Berlin, 5.Re1
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...d5 with the knight blocking on d6; plan 3 routed the f3-knight d2-f1-g3; plan 4 gave Black a bishop pair not yet won. Rewritten around 5...Nd6 6.Nxe5 Be7 7.Bf1. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Open Berlin, Main Line 9.Nc3 (Rio de Janerio)
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a knight route Nd2-f1-g3 with no knight on d2; plan 3 sent the b7-knight via a5 to c4 instead of the standard c5-e6; plan 4 was vague. Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Open Berlin, Main Line 9.Nc3 (Rio de Janerio)
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Re1 (already played) and Bf1 (the bishop is on c1); plan 2 routed the knight via d8 (the queen is there). Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Winawer Attack, Ruy Lopez
pages.notes: Plan 1 pressed a c5-pawn that doesn't exist and routed Nc3-a4-b6 with the knight on b1; plan 2 said ...c5 liquidates the doubled pawns. Fixed; overview reworded (it called the line Open Ruy Lopez). British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Exchange Variation, Romanovsky Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 castled before the f8-bishop could move; plan 1 overstated the endgame and had White castle long to press a d-file blocked by its own pawn. Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Exchange, 5.O-O Bg4 6.h3
pages.notes: Plan 1 named an impossible f4-g4-f5 pawn route. Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Exchange, Alapin Gambit, 7.d3 Qf6 8.Nbd2
pages.notes: Plan 4 had an e7-g6 route from g8 and plan 3 said 'diffuse' for 'defuse'. Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Exchange, Bronstein, 6.d3
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed Na3-c2-e3 and pushed f4 through the f3-knight; plan 2 said ...c5 undoubles the c-pawns. Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Exchange Variation, Alapin Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 had an impossible ...Rf6-h6 lift; plan 2 recommended 7.d4 or 7.c3 rather than the main 7.d3; plan 3 said 8.Ng5 blocks the h-file and understated the danger of accepting. Rewritten. British spelling.
